description: MainViewModel.kt defines the MainViewModel class for the Android app, managing UI-related data and interactions with the underlying NodeRuntime, including chat, camera, gateway, and preferences management.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing state and interactions for the main UI, including chat, camera, gateway, and preferences.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches UI lifecycle and permission management to camera and SMS managers.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets foreground status for the runtime and updates its state accordingly.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name in preferences.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the camera in preferences.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode in preferences.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location in preferences.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents or allows sleep mode via preferences.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual connection settings.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets manual host in preferences.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets manual port in preferences.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS in manual settings.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Sets the gateway token in preferences.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets the bootstrap token for gateway in preferences.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Sets the gateway password in preferences.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed, initializing runtime if needed.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding in the runtime.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding packages from CSV string.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets max notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setVoiceScreenActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the voice screen.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles launch requests from the assistant, managing chat draft and auto-send.

methods.name: clearRequestedHomeDestination
methods.description: Clears the requested home destination state.

methods.name: clearChatDraft
methods.description: Clears the current chat draft.

methods.name: clearPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Clears the pending auto-send request for the assistant.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone.

methods.name: setSpeakerEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables speaker output.

methods.name: refreshGatewayConnection
methods.description: Refreshes the gateway connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a gateway endpoint.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a gateway endpoint with credentials.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Establishes a manual connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current runtime connection.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts a gateway trust prompt.

methods.name: declineGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines a gateway trust prompt.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIActionFromWebView
methods.description: Handles actions from WebView payload JSON.

methods.description: Verifies if a URL is trusted for canvas actions.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate
methods.description: Requests rehydration of the canvas state.

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes the home canvas overview if connected.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by key.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes current chat data.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes the list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.description: Sets the chat's thinking level.

methods.description: Switches current chat session.

methods.description: Sends a chat message with attachments.
